Stamps include 'MATERIAL: METHYL STABILIZED', 'DRUM NO. 425-24', 'GROSS WT. 1593', 'TARE WT. 10-10-24', 'NET WT. 10-10-24', 'MADE IN INDIA', and 'EXP DATE: WITHIN 1 YEAR FROM DATE'.
